html:
Here is an image of the Veil Nebula (Cygnus Loop). It is a nebula formed from the remains of a super-nova that exploded 5000 to 8000 years ago. Its distance is about 2000 light-years.


Technical details
Telescope: Takahashi SKY90 II with dedicated f 4.5 focal reducer (407mm focal length)
Sensor: Canon 40D unfiltered
Mount: lx200 10" classic
Guiding: DSI pro and PHD on the 10" SCT at f 4.0

40 frames of 300 seconds, 40 darks, 20 flats
Stacking in nebulosity
Processing in photoshop
